integrity: All general statements have a direct finite-field proof. The attached standard-library code reconstructs the signed Gram identity and completes the four-coordinate graph enumeration with exact integer arithmetic. No independent audit or priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The transfer requires nonsingular binary quadratic forms and the constant-plus-coordinate Walsh band. The exact general spectrum is given by a graph matrix; only the four-coordinate case is classified by a finite list of three polynomials. A coding-theoretic or Seidel-compression equivalent in prior literature is possible. Finite code tests independently corroborate the algebra and exhaust only the labelled four-vertex graph census.
title: Dual symplectic graphs govern first-Walsh-band sampling on binary quadrics
